description: This is a Dart source file implementing a Flutter app router class that defines route handling for navigation within a Flutter application. It manages static and dynamic routes, parsing route parameters such as folder and document IDs, and provides fallback handling for unknown routes.

classes.name: AppRouter
classes.description: A central router class for handling named route generation, supporting static routes and dynamic routes with IDs for folders and documents.

classes.name: _FolderScreen
classes.description: Placeholder widget for displaying folder details based on folder ID.

classes.name: _DocumentScreen
classes.description: Placeholder widget for displaying document details based on document ID.

classes.name: _ErrorScreen
classes.description: Widget displaying an error message for route parsing issues.

methods.name: onGenerateRoute
methods.description: Main static method that generates routes based on the RouteSettings, handling static and dynamic routes.

methods.name: _tryMatchWithId
methods.description: Helper method to match and extract ID segments from paths like '/folder/123'.

methods.name: _extractId
methods.description: Helper method to parse and retrieve integer ID from route path or arguments.

methods.name: _error
methods.description: Creates a route for displaying an error screen with a message.
